gen-gf-revalia-gf-duru-sans: Loose-limbed and loud, with plenty of space between letters. Revalia owns the attention, while Duru Sans stays out of its way with wide openings on small letters and barely-there ascenders.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-funnel-sans: Flashy and relaxed, with a tall, stretched-out stride. Funnel Sans backs it up with plain sans steadiness, every stroke holding its width from stem to curve, and an e that opens wide.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-gidole: That open-bottomed g announces Revalia before anything else. Gidole follows with plain sans neon-tube strokes that never vary in width, and terminals held apart like open scissor blades, midline set high.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-liter: Swagger up top, structure underneath, and no shyness. Revalia is best at loud statements, while Liter, a modern sans with no stroke contrast, is best at tall, steady lines.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Loose-limbed and loud, with plenty of space between letters. Noto Sans Bamum is the plain sans foil, best at big open counters and curves that stop before turning in, while Revalia does the shouting.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-batak: Loud and loose, Revalia strides across the line with a tall band of letters and short stalks. Noto Sans Batak, a plain sans, is best at towering lowercase and an e that never squeezes shut.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Relaxed swagger meets a quiet, upright partner. Revalia is best at show-off letterforms, while Noto Sans Bengali, a sans with capitals barely taller than lowercase, is best at open-mouthed clarity.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-carian: Wide-striding display type with a lazy, confident gait. Noto Sans Carian, a sans-serif with terminals that stay apart like open scissor blades, sits quietly underneath so Revalia keeps the spotlight.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Loose and loud on top, with a long, easy stride. Noto Sans Deseret, a sans-serif with open apertures, a wide-looking lowercase and squat ascenders, settles in underneath Revalia and keeps every line legible.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-duployan: Expressive letters stroll along with a relaxed, wide-spaced stride. Revalia is best at turning heads, while Noto Sans Duployan, a sans with a wide-mouthed a and oversized counters, is best at staying readable.
